articles.title: BJP Strength Rises in Bihar Council as Two Independent MLCs Join Party
articles.summary: A major and significant political transformation has unfolded in Bihar politics in the wake of the recent legislative council election results. The strength of the Bharatiya Janata Party, commonly known as the BJP, in the Bihar Legislative Council has received a notable boost as two newly elected independent MLCs officially joined the party.

articles.title: BJP Criticizes Karnataka Congress Government Over Sting Operation Probe Doubts
articles.summary: Senior Bharatiya Janata Party leader R Ashoka criticized the ruling Congress government in Karnataka on Wednesday. The attack followed comments from Karnataka Pradesh Congress Committee chief BK Hariprasad, who expressed doubts about the fairness of an investigation into a sting controversy involving former Chief Minister Siddaramaiah. Ashoka stated that the government has lost its right to govern.

articles.title: Bihar’s Akanksha Hostels Gain Popularity Among Working Women, All Seats Filled in Patna
articles.summary: All available seats at the hostels in Patna and Muzaffarpur have been occupied, reflecting the growing demand for secure housing among women professionals. The Women and Child Development Corporation, under the Social Welfare Department , has appealed to eligible working women to apply for accommodation at hostels operating in Gaya and Bhagalpur and other locations where seats are available.

articles.title: Harmanpreet, Shilanand lead India's goal fest as hosts thrash South Korea 8-1, set ACT

articles.title: Viral video falsely claims India Defence Minister criticized army over border tensions
articles.summary: A viral video falsely attributes statements to India Defence Minister Rajnath Singh regarding India-China border tensions and Indian Army personnel. Fact checkers confirmed the footage is digitally manipulated and actually shows Singh responding to political remarks made by Congress President Mallikarjun Kharge in Patna. Artificial intelligence detection tools flagged both the video and audio as deepfakes.

articles.title: 1 dead, 3 injured after helicopters crash in midair near Mount Everest
articles.summary: A midair collision between two helicopters near Mount Everest on Tuesday left one person dead and three others injured, authorities said. Officials with Nepal’s civil aviation authority said a tourist from India was killed, The New York Times reported. Both pilots and a visitor from New Zealand were injured, according to the newspaper.

articles.title: Student activists protest in Patna to condemn mob rule and defend democracy
articles.summary: Akhil Bharatiya Vidyarthi Parishad members took out a protest march in Patna on Friday to condemn mob rule and defend constitutional institutions. Led by national secretary Abhay Pratap Singh and Delhi University Students Union president Yash Dabas, the participants marched toward Dak Bungalow Chauraha despite rainfall. They urged the youth to oppose anarchy through democratic means.

articles.title: WPL 2027 schedule announced, Vadodara and Mumbai to share hosting duties
articles.summary: The fifth edition of the Women's Premier League (WPL) will be played across Vadodara and Mumbai from January 14 to February 7, 2027, with the BCCI announcing the full schedule and venues for the tournament on Tuesday. articles.title: Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh Leader Urges Regime Change Through Ballots
articles.summary: Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh General Secretary Dattatreya Hosabale stated on November 4, 2026, in Indore that regime change must occur through elections rather than unrest. Addressing youth grievances and the Special Intensive Revision exercise, he emphasized that democratic processes and constructive dialogue remain essential for national stability. Any future changes will depend on resolving these issues.
